description: Returns the current text of a paragraph of the governing regulations straight from the eCFR, with its citation and URL: 26 CFR 1.45-6, 1.45-7, 1.45-8, 1.45-12, 1.48-13, 1.48E-3 and the Labor rules they rest on (29 CFR 541.101 owner exemption, 5.5 apprentices on Davis-Bacon work, 5.31 fringe, 29.5 program standards). Give a paragraph like "(d)" or "(g)(7)" to read one part; leave it out for the whole section. Sections: 1.45-6 (the 5x increased amount and when PWA applies to it); 1.45-7 (who is paid, which wage determination, corrections and penalties, definitions); 1.45-8 (labor hours (b), ratio (c), participation (d), examples (e), good faith and cure (f), definitions (g)); 1.45-12 (the records a taxpayer must keep for prevailing wage and apprenticeship); 1.48-13 (how 1.45-7/-8 apply to the energy credit, the 1 MW exception, alteration and repair); 1.48E-3 (how 1.45-7/-8 apply to section 48E facilities and energy storage); 541.101 (the 20% equity, actively-managing owner who is a bona fide exempt executive); 5.5 (apprentices: ratio, rates, registration (paragraph (a)(4))); 5.31 (cash, fringe benefits or a combination); 29.5 (what a registered program must provide: ratios, supervision, wage schedules).

paragraph.description: A paragraph such as (d), (g)(7) or (f)(1); shorthand g7 works. Leave out for the whole section.

name: read_regulation
title: Read the regulation text (live, eCFR)
